name: FSSAI basic registration
why: Check the applicable food-business registration route. FSSAI’s March 2026 reform introduced deemed registration for street food vendors registered with a Municipal Corporation or Town Vending Committee. Other food businesses should check FoSCoS for the applicable category.

name: Street vending certificate / ID
why: Street Vendors Act 2014: vending is allowed in notified zones with a certificate from the Town Vending Committee.
where: City corporation office (PMC in Pune, GBA in Bengaluru)

name: Shop and establishment registration
why: Needed for a fixed shop (Maharashtra Shops Act / Karnataka Shops Act).

name: City trade licence
why: Many trades in a fixed shop need a city trade licence.

name: Udyam registration
why: Free MSME identity. Helps with loans and schemes.
